title: Integrability of the absolute tail
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite measure on $\mathbb{R}$ such that $x\mapsto |x|$ is integrable with respect to $\nu$. For $t\in\mathbb{R}$, define the absolute tail as the measure of $\{x\in\mathbb{R}:t<|x|\}$. This tail is integrable as a function of $t$ on $(0,\infty)$.
